description: E7 with commercial models via API: Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5 (Anthropic Messages API, without the temperature parameter, which these models do not accept, no extended thinking, answers capped at 512 tokens), with 4 and 8 agents. Only the model call leaves the host; agents, MCP server, services, collector, and policy stay on the measured host, as in E7. The token usage reported by the API is recorded per agent.
